title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 Vijesha IT Services LLP is a technology and education company delivering custom software, web and mobile applications, and scalable digital solutions for diverse clients. The organization designs impactful digital marketing strategies, intuitive UI/UX experiences, and robust e\-commerce platforms to help brands grow and operate efficiently. It supports businesses through cloud\-smart solutions and corporate training programs, while its EdTech platform offers IT and non\-IT courses, live expert sessions, and real\-world internships. With operations in India and the UK, Vijesha IT Services LLP combines global best practices with local market insights. The company fosters a collaborative, inclusive culture and is driven by a mission to make technology and education accessible and engaging.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Digital Marketing Executive role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Koramangala. This role involves planning and executing digital marketing campaigns across channels such as social media, search, and email to increase brand visibility and lead generation. The Digital Marketing Executive will create and optimize web and social media content, monitor campaign performance using web analytics tools, and prepare reports with insights and recommendations. Daily responsibilities include managing social media calendars, coordinating with design and content teams, and ensuring consistent brand messaging. The role also includes staying updated on digital marketing trends, competitor activities, and best practices to support continuous improvement of marketing strategies.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Candidates should possess strong Marketing skills with experience in planning and executing digital campaigns.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills, including clear written and verbal communication and collaboration with cross\-functional teams.
* Candidates should possess Social Media Marketing skills with hands\-on experience managing platforms such as Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, and YouTube.
* Candidates should possess Web Content Writing skills, including the ability to create engaging, brand\-aligned content for websites, blogs, and landing pages.
* Candidates should possess Web Analytics skills, including the ability to use tools like Google Analytics or similar platforms to track and optimize campaign performance.
* Relevant skills such as basic SEO/SEM knowledge, familiarity with marketing automation or CRM tools, and an understanding of PPC advertising are beneficial.
* A bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, is preferred.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work in a fast\-paced, on\-site team environment are advantageous.

title: Sales & Marketing Manager
description:
This job is provided by apna.co Job Responsibilities:Plan and execute daily live bird sales according to company production schedules Develop and maintain strong relationships with wholesalers, retailers, and institutional customers.
   

  

 Monitor daily market prices and recommend competitive pricing strategies.
   

  

 Coordinate with production and farm teams to ensure timely bird availability.
   

  

 Achieve monthly and annual sales volume and revenue targets.
   

  

 Ensure birds are marketed at the optimum body weight and age for maximum profitability.
   

  

 Coordinate transportation and logistics for timely delivery of live birds.
   

  

 Resolve customer complaints regarding bird quality, weight, or delivery.
   

  

 Monitor competitor activities, pricing, and market trends.
   

  

 Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports for management review.
   

  

 Ensure compliance with company SOPs, biosecurity protocols, and quality standards during marketing operations.
   

  

 Minimize mortality and weight loss during loading, transportation, and delivery.
   

  

 Coordinate with finance teams for customer payments, collections, and credit management.
   

  

 Identify new markets and expand the customer base in assigned territories.
   

  

 Forecast customer demand and communicate requirements to production planning teams.
   

  

 Conduct regular customer visits to strengthen business relationships and improve customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Support promotional campaigns and marketing initiatives to increase market share.
   

  

 Ensure accurate documentation of sales transactions, dispatch records, invoices, and customer data.
   

  

 Continuously improve sales performance through market analysis, operational efficiency, and adherence to integrated poultry management practices.Ensure payment collection within given timeline
